method: Country-specific piecewise anchor histories with dimension-specific evidence and explicit temporal gates.
evidence_rules: Davis Cup and Grand Slam outcomes inform competition/tradition only.
Current participation/membership facts never backcast into earlier years.
Combined tennis/padel KNLTB membership is treated as organised-scale context, not tennis-only participation.
Swedish historical development/support is not mechanically inferred from elite team titles.
No held-out validation ranking is used to tune authored ratings.
